outcome: Discharge diagnoses (presumed sepsis, respiratory distress, neonatal jaundice, respiratory distress syndrome)
cohort: 1607 newborns admitted to hospitals across Jamaica during a 3-month period
finding: Prematurity, multiple gestation, macrosomia, maternal diabetes, maternal hypertension, and low 5-minute Apgar score were independent predictors of neonatal admission.
mod_finding: Infants of women who delivered by cesarean section were 2.1 times more likely to be admitted than infants of women who delivered vaginally.
